rawContent: So, I just found out that one of my Social Inequalities students won a Pro-Vice Chancellor Award for a paper he wrote on climate change as a manifestation of settler colonialism in Canada. Some people in government could learn a lot from him!!! #ClimateEmergency
Covid was just the dress rehearsal. #ClimateEmergency #ClimateCrisis
